title: Keep a registered run's work claim live for the whole launcher run so its record is not refused on a lapsed claim
outcome: Keep a registered run's work claim live for the whole launcher run so its record is not refused on a lapsed claim
acceptance: A registered launcher run longer than the claim's TTL (for example a 70-minute FULL under a 60-minute claim) ends with its verification record accepted: the run keeps the holder's claim live, for example by renewing it with the existing same-holder claim renewal at the launcher heartbeat, without changing the claim's identity or fence
If the claim is genuinely released, handed off or recovered by another session during the run, the record is still refused with field claim, as today
A behaviour test runs a registered run across the claim's original expiry and observes the record acknowledged
